pins.name: COM
pins.notes: Common line to GND. On some keypads the common is pin 2: check with a multimeter

pins.name: K1
pins.notes: Key 1: to a GPIO with INPUT_PULLUP, reads LOW when pressed

sources.title: Common 1x4 membrane keypad
